Language preference per user, tenant default and browser negotiation (P1) - Catalog: F553 - Evidence: dfc68b2; real Chromium on both entrances of an offline install on `ownsolid-cpu` upgraded in place to schema 37, 2026-11-06

Keyboard navigation, focus order and screen-reader labels on all pages (P1) - Catalog: F569 - Evidence: 27d03fc; keyboard walk and axe-core in real Chromium on both entrances of an offline install on `ownsolid-cpu`, 2026-11-05

Warn before a session ends from inactivity, with one action to stay signed in (P1) - Evidence: 62b3448; a real 60-second idle timeout with the page's poll running in Chromium on the admin entrance of an offline install on `ownsolid-cpu`, 2026-11-06

Shareable links: filters, sort order and the open drawer live in the URL (P1) - Evidence: fb4eac6; real Chromium reloaded a filtered email list from its address on both entrances of an offline install on `ownsolid-cpu`, 2026-11-06

Account page: profile, password change and linked sign-in providers (P1) - Evidence: 46d2fbb, 9267698; real browser on both entrances of an offline install on `ownsolid-cpu`, and link and unlink against Gitea 28.1.0 on the admin entrance, 2026-11-05

Mail delivery status for administrators, so a failed invitation or reset email can be seen and resent (P1) - Evidence: ec65295; a real failed reset email resent from the console in Chromium on a licensed offline install on `ownsolid-cpu`, 2026-11-05

Precompressed web assets: the build writes gzip and Brotli copies and the control plane serves them by `Accept-Encoding` (P1) - Evidence: 82b0830; real Chromium received Brotli copies on both entrances of an offline install on `ownsolid-cpu`, 2026-11-06

Single-key shortcuts for common actions (the prototype's D, I, N, K), with an account setting to turn them off as WCAG 2.2 criterion 2.1.4 requires (P1). Open: `N`, `D`, `K`, `/`, `?` and the switch work; `I` waits for the catalog

Navigation to [ADR 0037](../../decisions/0037-simple-on-the-surface-deep-underneath.md): collapsing groups with only the current one open, self-cleaning open state, a heading that only opens and closes, a filter box, and a collapsed icon-only mode that keeps every accessible name (P1) - Evidence: d85452f; real Chromium on an installation on `ownsolid-cpu` upgraded in place to schema 46, two runs

Pinned destinations, chosen by the person and kept per person (P1) - Evidence: 7a36453; real Chromium on an installation on `ownsolid-cpu` upgraded in place to schema 48, with the pin reaching a second browser

One advanced fold per form: the common path first, everything with a working default behind it, the count shown on the fold, and nothing without a safe default hidden (P1) - Evidence: 6210c2e; real Chromium on an installation on `ownsolid-cpu` upgraded in place to schema 48
Summary tiles above a list filter the list instead of decorating it (P1) - Evidence: feff70a; real Chromium on an installation on `ownsolid-cpu` upgraded in place to schema 48

Resource detail pages with their own tabs, related resources and activity, rather than only a drawer over the list (P1) - Evidence: 39cc736, cdf7ee9; real Chromium on an installation on `ownsolid-cpu` at schema 48, on a joined node, the administrator and a connector with a real Gitea

Moving through a list from the keyboard: `j` and `k` move the row selection and Enter opens it, under the switch UX-122 adds (P1) - Evidence: 5823524; real Chromium on an installation on `ownsolid-cpu` upgraded in place to schema 48, two runs

English strings load as their own chunk like the other languages, so the first download stops growing with every page, and its limit comes back down (P1) - Evidence: 04e6554; real Chromium on an installation on `ownsolid-cpu` at schema 48, first download 141.8 kB
Message catalogs split by page, so a page downloads only its own strings, once a catalog is large enough to repay the key-to-page map ([research](../../research/message-catalogs.md)) (P2)
Wall display and NOC dashboards for operations centers (P2)
Branding: logo, product name and theme per installation (P2) - Catalog: F060, F061
Translation pipeline: string extraction, glossary, placeholder checks, reviewed language packs (P2) - Catalog: F546 to F551, F554, F556 to F564
Remaining languages from the 249-language target, with RTL and fonts (P4) - Catalog: F546
Mobile companion for alerts and approvals (P4)

portal.md.text: Portal shell: the person's workspace switcher, grouped navigation, command menu, and a home that answers what is running, what it cost and what needs them (P1)
Assistants and conversations: chat with what has been published to the workspace, with history that never leaves the installation (P1)
Applications: open and install the apps an administrator published to this workspace, and nothing else (P1)
Model catalogue for users: which models this workspace may call, what each one costs, and what it is good for (P1)
Playground: try a model against a prompt, compare two, and copy the call that produced the answer (P1)

API keys and endpoints: issue, name, rotate and revoke my own keys; the endpoint, a code sample per language, and my own call log (P1) - Evidence: c20a9df, 4b62fef; live run on an installation, 2026-11-08: a non-administrator invited through a real mail flow issued, rotated and revoked a key from the portal against a real control plane and database, calls admitted over the real gateway protocol by a stand-in for the gateway process (GW-114) and read per key; an administrator's portal session got 404 for that key, and another workspace was refused. No model ran; the three samples were run against a local HTTPS stub with the real OpenAI SDKs and curl
Jobs: submit training, batch and scientific jobs, watch their steps and logs, open their results, and re-run one (P1)
Workspaces: notebooks and development environments I own, with the resource they hold shown against my quota (P1)
Data: my datasets and files, their size against my storage quota, and what a job did with them (P1)
Evaluation: start a run against a model I may call, and read the score beside the runs before it (P1)
Usage and quota: tokens, GPU hours and budget used against what I was given, with the day it will run out (P1)
Account: my profile, my password, my sessions, and the ones I want ended (P1)

In-product help that works offline, reachable from every page (P1) - Evidence: 779c1558 and the [portal Chromium help flows](../../../web/apps/portal/e2e/help.spec.ts); the existing offline installation run served the articles and portal-only API reference, and local Chromium on 2026-11-09 opened the contextual article on every signed-in portal screen with an article, checked the fallback and filtered empty states, and reached help without requests outside the installation origin
Every portal page reads its scope from the session, with a test that a parameter naming another workspace is refused rather than filtered (P1)
Ask for more: a quota request an administrator approves, with the reason and the decision recorded (P2)
Share within the workspace: hand an app, a key's scope or a dataset to a colleague, within what the workspace holds (P2)
Notifications: my job finished, my budget is nearly gone, my key is about to expire (P2)

portal.md.text: Portal shell: the person's workspace switcher, grouped navigation, command menu, and a home that answers what is running, what it cost and what needs them (P1)
Assistants and conversations: chat with what has been published to the workspace, with history that never leaves the installation (P1)
Applications: open and install the apps an administrator published to this workspace, and nothing else (P1)

No model ran; the three samples were run against a local HTTPS stub with the real OpenAI SDKs and curl

Workspaces: notebooks and development environments I own, with the resource they hold shown against my quota (P1)
Data: my datasets and files, their size against my storage quota, and what a job did with them (P1)
Evaluation: start a run against a model I may call, and read the score beside the runs before it (P1)
Usage and quota: tokens, GPU hours and budget used against what I was given, with the day it will run out (P1)
Account: my profile, my password, my sessions, and the ones I want ended (P1)

In-product help that works offline, reachable from every page (P1) - Evidence: 779c1558 and the [portal Chromium help flows](../../../web/apps/portal/e2e/help.spec.ts); the existing offline installation run served the articles and portal-only API reference, and local Chromium on 2026-11-09 opened the contextual article on every signed-in portal screen with an article, checked the fallback and filtered empty states, and reached help without requests outside the installation origin
Every portal page reads its scope from the session, with a test that a parameter naming another workspace is refused rather than filtered (P1)

Share within the workspace: hand an app, a key's scope or a dataset to a colleague, within what the workspace holds (P2)
Notifications: my job finished, my budget is nearly gone, my key is about to expire (P2)
